newsitem.title: USA: MidAmerican 675 MW unit seen up on weekend.
newsitem.headline: MidAmerican 675 MW unit seen up on weekend.

text.p: MidAmerican Energy Co's 675 megawatt Council Bluffs coal fired power unit 3 in Council Bluffs, Iowa, was expected to return to service over the weekend following a repair outage, a spokesman said Friday.
The unit was shut Jan 8 for a boiler tube leak repair.
"We expect it to be back on line over the weekend," spokesman John McCarroll said.
MidAmerican is the operator and majority owner of the Council Bluffs unit.
Despite below-normal temperatures in the area, McCarroll said MidAmerican is meeting customer demand, and does not expect to purchase surplus power to replace that lost by the Council Bluffs outage.
MidAmerican serves about 635,000 electric and 600,000 natural gas customers located primarily in Iowa and in portions of Illinois, South Dakota and Nebraska.
The company's electricity demand peaks in the summer, McCarroll said.
